fields.why: Table 1 gives one chi-square p-value per characteristic for B.1.526 vs non-VOI/VOC, so the SPD is a margin of each test (rule 2 and rule 6).
Age (5 groups, p = 0.04), race/ethnicity (5, p<0.001) and neighborhood poverty (4, p<0.001) each have a single test across their levels. Sex has 2 levels and borough is geography, so neither enters.
Each is one chi-square across all levels with no per-level contrasts, so omnibus with resolves_to_finer false is right. The age entry's evidence is only a row label, not the test note.
